app.name: Sogasho Outdoor Sales & Audit
app.description: Outdoor field sales, performance analytics and audit control for Sogasho.

dashboard.title: dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: The app frame is ready. Sales, stock and performance figures appear here once those phases are built.

designSystem.title: brand check
designSystem.intro: Every colour, font and component below comes from the Sogasho brand kit. Use this page to review the look before business screens are built.

states.errorBody: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact your Super Admin.
states.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

access.deniedBody: Your role does not include this page. Contact your Super Admin if you need it.

users.title: users
users.name: Name
users.noMobile: No mobile number — cannot sign in
users.temporaryAgent: Temporary agent (signs in with phone + password + SMS code)
users.permanentStaff: Permanent staff (signs in with email + password + SMS code)
users.phoneHint: Somaliland mobile, e.g. 063 412 3456. The sign-in SMS code goes to this number.
users.phoneHintAgent: Temporary agents also sign in with this number. Changing it changes their sign-in.
users.rolesHint: Choose at least one. Agents get "Sales Agent".
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out of everything immediately and cannot sign in until reactivated.
users.confirmReactivate: Reactivate {name}? They will be able to sign in again.
users.confirmReset: Create a new temporary password for {name}? Their current password stops working.
users.passwordBody: Give this password to {name} privately. It is shown only once. They must choose a new one at their next sign-in.
users.createdButNotAssigned: The sign-in account was created, but roles or team could not be saved:
users.leaderHint: Only people with the Team Leader / Supervisor role appear here. To add one: Users tab → ⋯ → Edit → tick Team Leader / Supervisor → Save.
users.noTeams: No teams yet. Add the first team.
users.matrixIntro: What each role may do, and for whose data: own = only their own records, team = their team, city = their city, all = everyone. Super Admin always has everything.

errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.checkFields: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.emailRequired: Enter a valid email for permanent staff.
errors.phoneRequired: Enter a valid Somaliland mobile number.
errors.phoneTaken: Another account of the same type already has this mobile number.
errors.alreadyExists: An account with this email or phone already exists.
errors.teamNotInCity: That team belongs to another city.
errors.ownSuperAdmin: You cannot remove your own Super Admin role.
errors.lastSuperAdmin: At least one active Super Admin must remain.
errors.deactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.leaderRole: The Team Leader must have the Team Leader role.
errors.superAdminLocked: The Super Admin role always has every permission.
errors.teamNameTaken: A team with this name already exists.
errors.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.signInIntro: Agents: use your phone number. Staff: use your email.
auth.verifyIntro: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.verifyIntroNoPhone: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to your phone. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.changePasswordIntro: For your security, replace the temporary password before you continue.
auth.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
auth.inactive: Your account is not active. Contact your Super Admin.
auth.notConfigured: The app is not connected to Supabase yet. Add the Supabase settings to .env.local.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.otpInvalid: That code is not correct. Check the SMS and try again.
auth.otpExpired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
auth.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Send a new code.
auth.otpNoChallenge: No active code. Send a new code.
auth.otpResent: A new code has been sent.
auth.otpRateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again in 15 minutes.
auth.smsNotConfigured: SMS sending is not set up yet. Contact your Super Admin.
auth.smsFailed: We could not send the SMS. Try again in a moment.
auth.smsNoPhone: There is no mobile number on your account, so we cannot send your code. Ask your Super Admin to add one.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordNeedsLetter: The password must contain at least one letter.
auth.passwordNeedsDigit: The password must contain at least one number.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordSameAsOld: Choose a password different from the temporary one.
auth.passwordRejected: This password was not accepted. Choose a stronger one.
